description: Scribus 1.7.3 with Photoshop-style image editor and SAM AI Smart Select. Full Malayalam font suite + fcitx5 with the Deshabhimani m17n layout.
_comment_volume_mappings: SAM models: bind-mount ONE read-only copy per agent over /opt/scribus/sam
instead of baking 43 MB into the image. kasm-launch.sh symlinks
~/.config/scribus/sam -> /opt/scribus/sam at session start, so the models
never get duplicated into each user's persistent profile.
Omit the /opt/scribus/sam entry if you built with INCLUDE_SAM_MODELS=true.
